# Module `lune_ui_wgpu::custom`

[API reference](../INDEX.md) / parent [`lune_ui_wgpu`](index.md)

Custom draw items: app-owned GPU drawing that sits inside a painted layer.

The painter records a [`CustomItem`](../lune-ui-core/scene.md#struct.CustomItem) with [`Painter::custom`](../lune-ui-core/paint.md#method.Painter.custom).
[`FrameRenderer::draw_with`](frame.md#method.FrameRenderer.draw_with) draws it after that
layer's acrylic and under shapes and before its text, with the scissor set to the item's
clip. Because the item lives in a layer, a popup's backdrop blur sees it when the layer is
below the popup.

Source: `crates/lune-ui-wgpu/src/custom.rs:1`

## Traits

<a id="trait.CustomDraw"></a>
### Trait `CustomDraw`

```rust
pub trait CustomDraw { .. }
```

App-owned drawing. The app passes one implementation per slot to
[`FrameRenderer::draw_with`](frame.md#method.FrameRenderer.draw_with).

Source: `crates/lune-ui-wgpu/src/custom.rs:30`

**Required items**

- <a id="tymethod.CustomDraw.prepare"></a>`fn prepare(&mut self, device: &wgpu::Device, queue: &wgpu::Queue, frame: &CustomFrame)`

  Called once per frame, before the first render pass, for every supplied implementation
  (whether or not an item refers to it). Upload buffers and textures here.

- <a id="tymethod.CustomDraw.render"></a>`fn render(&self, pass: &mut wgpu::RenderPass<'_>, frame: &CustomFrame)`

  Records draw calls into `pass`, once for every item that refers to this slot (the scene
  pass and the final pass are separate; a slot is normally used by one layer only). The
  scissor is already set to the item's clip.
